{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Elite Lead''' is a tanky [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has high health and average speed. It initially spawns with [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]], meaning only towers with lead detection can damage it, and with the [[Stun Immunity]], meaning stuns are less effective on it while knockback does not affect it. However, once it loses all of its [[Shield Health]], it will lose its covering and also the [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] and [[Stun Immunity]] attributes it has by default. To compensate however, it will increase its speed to 5 once all of its coverings are lost. ==Logbook Description== "''Taking the same concept as the Lead, the Elite Lead are Swifts who have fallen victim to the same process as the Odds. Though, more careful consideration was taken for their armor due to mobility reasons.''" ==Appearance== The '''Elite Lead''' is a humanoid entirely covered with grey metal armor. Upon losing all of its [[Shield Health]], it will usually lose most of its metal coverings, revealing that it is an entity with grey skin, purple substance on its hands and purple veins. In its torso, it has a giant hole with a purple crystal. The '''Elite Lead''' will lose one piece of its armor covering (head, torso, left leg, right leg, left arm, right leg) at random every time it loses one sixth of its [[Shield Health]], or a covering loss every 25 health lost. In cases of it receiving more than 25 damage, like 50 damage at once, it will lose multiple pieces at once, which in the previously listed 50 damage's case that being two pieces of armor. The only exception to this is it losing all of its [[Shield Health]], as this happening does not actually remove any armor. This means there will always be at least one piece of armor left on the '''Elite Lead''', with it even being possible to have it keep all of its armor if the [[Shield Health]] received 150 damage at once. ==Strategy== *The '''Elite Lead''' has the [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] attribute until its shield health is depleted. **Towers with lead detection like the [[Engineer]], [[Golden Scout]] and [[Saboteur]] are required for dealing with the '''Elite Lead'''. **Once its coverings is removed, other towers like the [[Crook Boss]] or [[Minigunner]] can also be used even if they do not have lead detection. *The '''Elite Lead''' also has the [[Stun Immunity]], making stuns only slow it down. **Once it loses its [[Shield Health]], it will lose this immunity, making stuns far more effective. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|{{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Elite Lead''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} EliteLeadCA.png|'''Elite Lead''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ModernEliteLeadIconIG.png|'''Elite Lead''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Elite Lead''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Elite Lead''' added, replacing the [[Lead Boss]]. {{Hardcore|[[Lead]]|Wave 14|Elite Lead|Wave 16|[[Mystery]]|Wave 17}} {{Voidcore|[[Lead]]|Wave 13|Elite Lead|Wave 15|[[Mystery]]|Wave 16}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
